title: Amafayela Alandiwe Aya Kuphi? Umhlahlandlela we-Android ne-iPhone
description: Awulitholi ifayela olilandile? Bheka lapho amafayela alandiwe aya khona ku-Android, iPhone, iPad nakukhompyutha, nendlela yokudlulisela ividiyo ku-Gallery.
photo2Caption: Ku-laptop, amafayela aya kufolda ethi Downloads.
body:
Usucindezele inkinobho yokulanda, kodwa ividiyo awuyitholi ku-gallery? Ungakhathazeki, le yinkinga evame kakhulu. Ngokuvamile ifayela selivele lilondoloziwe, kodwa likufolda ehlukile kunaleyo obucabanga ngayo. Lo mhlahlandlela uchaza lapho amafayela alandiwe alondolozwa khona ku-Android, iPhone, iPad, nakukhompyutha, kanye nendlela yokuwadlulisela ukuze kube lula ukuwavula.

Incazelo engezansi isebenza kumafayela owalanda nge-browser, kuhlanganise amavidiyo, umsindo, nezithombe ezivela ku-I Need Save. Amafayela athunyelwa ngqo esuka enkundleni yangempela aye kudivayisi yakho futhi awagcinwa kuseva ye-I Need Save, ngakho ikhophi ikufoni noma ku-laptop yakho kuphela.

Indawo yamafayela alandiwe ku-Android

Ku-Android, amafayela alandwe nge-browser angena kufolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe). Indlela yokuyivula:

  1. Vula i-app yokuphatha amafayela efonini yakho. Igama layo liyahluka kuye ngomkhiqizo, isibonelo My Files, Files, noma File Manager.
  2. Khetha Okulandiwe noma Downloads.
  3. Hlela ngosuku lwakamuva ukuze amafayela osanda kuwalanda abe phezulu.
  4. Thepha ifayela ukuze lidlale, noma ulicindezele isikhashana ukuze ulidlulisele, uqambe kabusha, noma wabelane ngalo.

Enye indlela esheshayo: vula imenyu ye-browser, bese ukhetha ingxenye yokulanda (Downloads). Lapho kunohlu lwamafayela osanda kuwalondoloza, futhi ungawavula ngqo lapho.

Kungani ividiyo ingakaveli ku-Gallery?

I-app ye-Gallery kwesinye isikhathi idinga isikhashana ukuze iskene amafayela amasha. Uma ividiyo ingakabonakali, linda kancane, bese uvala uphinde uvule i-app ye-Gallery. Kwamanye amafoni, amavidiyo avela kufolda ethi Download aboniswa e-albhamu ehlukile ebizwa ngokuthi Download noma Downloads, ngakho hlola nohlu lwama-albhamu.

Indawo yamafayela alandiwe ku-iPhone naku-iPad

Ku-iPhone naku-iPad, amafayela alandwe nge-Safari awangeni ngqo ku-app ethi Photos. Alondolozwa ku-app ethi Files (Amafayela) kufolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe).

Ukuze ividiyo ibukwe ku-app ethi Photos, landela lezi zinyathelo:

  1. Vula i-app ethi Files.
  2. Ngena kufolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe).
  3. Thepha ividiyo ofuna ukuyidlulisela ize ivuleke.
  4. Thepha inkinobho ethi Share (Yabelana).
  5. Khetha Save Video (Londoloza Ividiyo).

Ngemuva kwalokho ividiyo izovela ku-app ethi Photos kanye namanye amavidiyo. Ezithombeni, izinyathelo ziyafana: vula isithombe ku-Files, thepha okuthi Share, bese ukhetha inketho yokulondoloza isithombe.

Uma ividiyo isilondoloziwe ku-Photos, ungayisusa ikhophi esefolda ethi Downloads ukuze indawo yokugcina ye-iPhone yakho ihlale inesikhala.

Indawo yamafayela alandiwe ku-laptop nakukhompyutha

Kokubili ku-Windows naku-Mac, amafayela alandwe nge-browser ngokuvamile angena kufolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe).

  • I-Windows: vula i-File Explorer, bese uchofoza okuthi Downloads kuphaneli engakwesobunxele.
  • I-Mac: vula i-Finder, bese ukhetha okuthi Downloads ku-sidebar.
  • Ku-browser: vula uhlu lokulanda lwe-browser. Ku-Chrome ye-Windows, isibonelo, ungacindezela u-Ctrl+J.

Uma wake washintsha izilungiselelo ze-browser ukuze amafayela alondolozwe kwenye ifolda, hlola leyo folda ezilungiselelweni zokulanda ze-browser yakho.

Amafayela omsindo nezithombe alondolozwa kuphi?

Indawo iyafana neyamavidiyo. Umsindo, kungaba ngowekhwalithi yangempela noma i-MP3 ye-192 kbps eguqulwe evidiyweni, uzongena kufolda ethi Downloads. Kunjalo nangezithombe nezithonjana. Ku-Android, amafayela e-MP3 ngokuvamile angadlalwa ku-app yokuphatha amafayela noma ku-app yomculo. Ku-iPhone, amafayela omsindo angadlalwa ngqo ku-app ethi Files.

Uma ufuna ukwazi indlela yokuthatha umsindo evidiyweni, funda umhlahlandlela othi indlela yokuguqula amavidiyo ezinkundla zokuxhumana abe yi-MP3.

Alikho ifayela nhlobo? Hlola lokhu

  • Ukulanda akukaqedi. Amanye amavidiyo adinga ukucutshungulwa kuqala, futhi inkinobho izobonisa okuthi Iyalungisa…. Linda kuze kuqale ukulanda ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi ungalivali ikhasi ngokushesha.
  • Indawo yokugcina igcwele. Uma isitoreji sesicishe saphela, ukulanda kungehluleka. Khulula isikhala esincane bese uzama futhi.
  • Okuqukethwe akukwazi ukulandwa. Okuqukethwe okuyimfihlo, okudinga ukungena ngemvume, noma okukhawulelwe ngokwesifunda ngempela akukwazi ukulondolozwa.

Uma usulitholile ifayela kodwa lingadlali, bheka izixazululo endatshaneni ethi ividiyo elandiwe ayidlali.

Enye into: londoloza okuqukethwe ukuze ukusebenzise wena kuphela futhi uhloniphe amalungelo obunikazi abadali. Uma ufuna ukuphinda ukuthumele, qala ucele imvume futhi ubalule igama lomdali.

Imibuzo evame ukubuzwa

Ingabe indawo yokulondoloza amafayela alandiwe ingashintshwa?

Kukhompyutha, ama-browser amaningi akuvumela ukuthi ukhethe ifolda yokulanda kumenyu yezilungiselelo. Efonini, le nketho incike ku-browser nasesistimini oyisebenzisayo.

Kungani ku-iPhone ividiyo ingangeni ngqo ku-Photos?

I-Safari ilondoloza amafayela alandiwe ku-app ethi Files. Kudingeka uvule ividiyo ku-Files, uthephe okuthi Share, bese ukhetha okuthi Save Video.

Ingabe amafayela ami agcinwa kuseva ye-I Need Save?

Cha. Amafayela athunyelwa ngqo esuka enkundleni yangempela aye kudivayisi yakho, ngakho gcina kahle amafayela abalulekile.
